newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-BSkyB active on hopes of rally.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-BSkyB active on hopes of rally.

text.p: Expectations shares in British Sky Broadcasting will continue to recover within the next three months prompted fairly heavy buying of call options on the stock on Wednesday, dealers said.

In otherwise light activity, they noted the straight purchase of 1,300 March 600 calls in BSkyB. The shares, up 8-1/2p to 527p at 1408 GMT, would need to rise by more than 11 percent by March expiry for the calls to generate a profit.
Dealers also noted the outright purchase of some March 550 calls.
"I think the (call) buying relates to the fact that the shares have underperformed the market recently, and now some people are looking for them to outperform," said one dealer.
Extending their rebound from the five-month low of 473p set December 13, BSkyB shares rose as high as 538p on heavy volume earlier after positive comments from Merrill Lynch.
Sources said analyst Neil Blackley at Merrill had assumed coverage of the stock and had rated it "accumulate" with a price target of 560p. Blackley was not available for comment.
Reports earlier this week that the pay television operator would launch digital services in Britain next year and that the company cleared a key regulatory hurdle sparked the rebound in the shares.
Most activity in index options also revolved around rollover, with December index options and futures due to expire on Friday, they said.
